messages.subject: Nonconvergence Issue with WLS estimator
parts:
I am having an issue running a very simple model (single outcome variable, multiple groups, separate variance estimates, means fixed to be equal) in which the model seems to run fine with equal n across groups (e.g., 4 groups, sample sizes of 20, 20, 20, 20) but only converges about half the time with unequal n (e.g., 4 groups, sample sizes of 19,20,20,21). I am attaching the results of a simple simulation study in which you can see the issue. There are four groups and two conditions, one condition with sample sizes of 20,20,20,20 and one with sample sizes of 19,20,20,21. The means are all 0, the variances are all 10, and the distributions are all normal. 

In the final 'results' matrix the first column has the results (chi-square values) for the equal n condition, and the second column has the results for the unequal condition. NAs represent conditions in which the model did not converge. 

I hope there is a simple solution to this problem.

Rob

nsim<-50
ngroups<-4
ncond<-2

n<-matrix(c(20,20,20,20,19,20,20,21),nrow=ncond,ncol=ngroups,byrow=TRUE)
maxn<-max(n)
dv<-matrix(0,nrow=maxn,ncol=ngroups)
dv_n<-matrix(0,nrow=maxn,ncol=ngroups)
vars<-matrix(c(10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10),nrow=ncond,ncol=ngroups,byrow=TRUE)
sds<-sqrt(vars)
means<-matrix(c(0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0),nrow=ncond,ncol=ngroups,byrow=TRUE)
distshape<-matrix(c(0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0),nrow=ncond,ncol=ngroups,byrow=TRUE) 

results<-matrix(NA,nrow=nsim,ncol=ncond)

### Simulations #####
for (z in 1:ncond) {
  for (i in 1:nsim) {
    for (j in 1:ngroups) {
      dv[,j]<-rnorm(maxn)
      if (distshape[z,j]==0) dv_n[,j]<-dv[,j]*sds[z,j]+means[z,j]
      ifelse (j == 1, newdata<-t(t(dv_n[1:n[z,1],j])), newdata<-rbind(newdata,t(t(dv_n[1:n[z,j],j]))))
      ifelse (j==1,iv<-t(t(rep(j,n[z,j]))), iv<-rbind(iv,t(t(rep(j,n[z,j])))))
    }
    
    newdat<-data.frame(newdata,iv)
    if (ngroups==4){
      mod1<-'newdata~c(aa,aa,aa,aa)*1
       newdata~~newdata' } 
      fit4<-sem(mod1,data=newdat,group='iv',estimator="WLS")
    
    ifelse (inspect(fit4,"converged")==TRUE,
            results[i,z]<-1-(pchisq(fitMeasures(fit4,"chisq"),ngroups-1)),
            results[i,z]<-NA)
   }
}

results

Yes, this is a known issue. I'm not sure why this is happening. It only
happens if the sample sizes are very small (and unequal). I need to
study this further, but it make take some time.

Yves.

This was a bug and has been fixed in the dev version (0.5-13). You can
install it by typing in R:

install.packages("lavaan", repos="http://www.da.ugent.be", type="source")

Yves.
